name: Vignesh Sundaresan
title: Software Developer with 8+ years of industry experience.
summary: Software engineer with 8+ years building and scaling SaaS products and internal platforms. Experienced across greenfield product development, event-driven backends, and leading small teams.

experience.summary: Trade Republic Bank GmbH is a German online broker and bank headquartered in Berlin.
bullets: Built and launched Resolve (Case Management System) to replace Zendesk fully, saving 1.5M/year.
Led the implementation of Email ticket creation, bringing Resolve ticket coverage to 100% and making Zendesk a fallback, using the Sendgrid email provider.
Implemented automations in Resolve to improve ticket coverage from 58% to 98%.
Built the base for emitting events in Resolve to build dashboards in Looker using Snowflake and Kinesis.

Contributed to development of a greenfield SaaS application enabling business owners to take complete control of their workflows. Part of a 10-member team that successfully launched Qntrl worldwide in September 2019.
Worked closely with the Head of Engineering and Head of Product to completely revamp the product to a new version, leading a team of 6 members. Launched the new version successfully as a BETA.
Evolved to become a module lead. Responsible for managing one developer, mentoring juniors, and performing code reviews.
Responsible for software maintenance across the codebase. Participated in user requirements gathering, project planning, design, implementation and testing.
Refactored legacy client-side and server-side code, improving page load time and query processing time by 20%.
